## Activity

Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 33 captures during October 2020. The activity provides a summary of image capture and subsequent grading for the month. All captures were included in the review process, with image quality assessed before grading outcomes were recorded.

The results should be considered alongside the image-quality findings below. Where images could not be graded, this is reported separately from the total activity and from the referable outcomes.

## Image quality

A total of 3 captures were assessed as ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 9.1. The clinic lead should continue to ensure that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. This will support appropriate follow-up and help maintain the quality of future captures.

## Grading

Grading identified 2 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1. This measure provides an indication of the usual time between image capture and completion of grading during October 2020. The site should continue monitoring grading timeliness and image quality through routine operational review.
